pending.description: There is work that blocks closing due to tab inactivity: an `offered` handoff, a `pending` action, an agent mid-turn, a dev agent working or blocked, or a conversational agent waiting for the user (RN-064, RN-581).

motivo.description: What is hanging. `null` when there's nothing.

aguardandoUsuarioDesde.description: Set ONLY when the one thing pending is a conversational agent waiting for the user (RN-581): the instant its turn ended. It is the only pending signal with a ceiling, and the engine applies it (`SESSION_CONVERSATION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS`, default 8h) — past it the session closes with `conversation_idle_timeout`. `null` otherwise.

403.description: Service token missing or different from the shared one.

404.description: Session, project, or resource not found.
